name: clinc150-gate
question: Is this user utterance something the assistant can handle?
instructions: The assistant handles a fixed set of 150 everyday personal-assistant intents: banking, travel, vehicles, small talk, utilities, work and home automation. Answer true if the utterance is a request of that kind, and false if it falls outside what the assistant covers.
source: CLINC150 (Larson et al., EMNLP 2019), CC BY-SA 3.0, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clinc/oos-eval/master/data/data_full.json
notes: Balanced 50/50: all 1,200 out-of-scope rows against an equal number of in-scope rows sampled with seed 0, so the majority-class baseline is 50%. The 150 intents are described to the model in the instructions rather than enumerated, because a Noul takes no option list.
